text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Mejiro Bright awaits her own debut, Mejiro Dober continues to train for her next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright notices the change in Mejiro Dober after her debut, and they make a promise to forge new Mejiro legacies together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Under the setting sun, Mejiro Dober swears to compete in the Triple Tiara and Mejiro Bright in the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to prepare for the Triple Tiara, Mejiro Dober decides to run in the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies first!
